description: Land Title Settlement Department - Nittambuwa Village, Attanagalla D/S Division, Gampaha District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land title registration under the Registration of Title Act. It contains a declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding the determination of title for a specific land parcel (Plot 169, Block 03) with detailed land particulars including owner information, extent, and classification. The content falls under "Land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as specified in Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
